n9a02ff0b70.headline: BRICS set to invite Saudi Arabia to join – Bloomberg News
n9a02ff0b70.summary: Major emerging market nations are preparing to invite Saudi Arabia to join BRICS, Bloomberg News reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
n9a02ff0b70.why: BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies, and expansion could shift trade, payments and oil-market dynamics.

nb9e330ec96.headline: TSX futures up on higher oil prices; bank earnings start on mixed note
nb9e330ec96.summary: Toronto futures edged higher on Thursday on oil prices as Canadian big bank earnings began on a mixed note, with Royal Bank of Canada beating profit estimates.
nb9e330ec96.why: The Toronto Stock Exchange is dominated by energy and banking stocks, so oil prices and bank earnings drive its direction.

impacts.name: Royal Bank of Canada
impacts.why: Beating profit estimates in quarterly results can support the bank's shares.

na5b79150c0.headline: CeMat launches development investment in a residential building with ground floor retail
na5b79150c0.summary: CeMat has decided to start its first residential building project, Moje Bielany, located in Bielany. The development includes ground-floor retail space.
na5b79150c0.why: CeMat is a Polish property developer, and its move into residential construction reflects demand for housing in Warsaw's suburbs.

n98e66bdd30.headline: Iran, Saudi Arabia and Egypt among 6 nations set to join BRICS economic bloc
n98e66bdd30.summary: BRICS leaders announced the admission of six new countries from next year, including Iran, Saudi Arabia and Egypt. The bloc said it aims to reshape the global order.
n98e66bdd30.why: BRICS is a group of large emerging economies whose expansion affects global trade, energy markets and efforts to reduce dependence on the dollar.

nd77dd53031.headline: Energy bills set to be higher for millions this winter despite lower gas prices
nd77dd53031.summary: Research found more than one in three UK households will pay higher energy bills this winter, despite lower gas prices. The increase reflects the wider energy price framework.
nd77dd53031.why: Household energy costs influence UK inflation, consumer spending and the policy outlook of the Bank of England.

na41da8ec2e.headline: Iran and Saudi Arabia are among 6 nations set to join China and Russia in the BRICS economic bloc
na41da8ec2e.summary: Iran and Saudi Arabia are among six nations invited to join the BRICS bloc, along with the United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Egypt and Ethiopia. The bloc already includes China and Russia.
na41da8ec2e.why: BRICS is a group of major emerging economies that coordinates trade, finance and development policy. Expansion changes its weight in global trade, energy markets and alternatives to Western-led institutions.

nd4ec925dd2.headline: Iran and Saudi Arabia among six nations set to join Brics economic bloc
nd4ec925dd2.summary: Iran, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Egypt and Ethiopia are set to join the BRICS bloc from 2024. The expansion would widen the group's membership across major oil-producing and emerging economies.
nd4ec925dd2.why: Membership expansion of BRICS can alter trade, energy and currency-settlement arrangements among large emerging economies and oil producers.

n3212dfb806.headline: CRH Profit Rose on Robust Pricing; Raises Dividend
n3212dfb806.summary: CRH reported a higher first-half pretax profit on robust pricing, which offset cost inflation, and raised its dividend payout, according to a report.
n3212dfb806.why: CRH is a building-materials group, one of the largest suppliers of aggregates, cement and asphalt, so its results reflect global construction activity and pricing power.

n7c3cd6df39.headline: Why Africans are signing up to have their eyeballs scanned for about $60 in crypto
n7c3cd6df39.summary: CNBC reported on people in Uganda and Kenya who have had their eyes scanned for about $60 in crypto through Worldcoin. The report focuses on participants' experiences.
n7c3cd6df39.why: Worldcoin is a crypto project that issues tokens in exchange for biometric identity scans, raising regulatory and data-privacy questions.

nabb22fb04d.headline: India, US close to resolving sole WTO row
nabb22fb04d.summary: India and the US are working to resolve their last pending trade dispute at the World Trade Organization, over poultry products. Six of seven disputes have already been resolved, and the parties aim to settle the seventh.
nabb22fb04d.why: The WTO settles trade disputes between member countries, and poultry access between India and the US is a bilateral trade issue with export implications.

na7f50f87da.headline: Xi: 'Expanded BRICS a New Chapter for Emerging Countries'
na7f50f87da.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping said the expansion of BRICS with six new countries represents a new chapter in cooperation among emerging and developing countries, with the expanded group representing 36% of global GDP.
na7f50f87da.why: BRICS is a major bloc of emerging economies whose expansion could shift global economic and geopolitical dynamics, affecting trade, investment, and development cooperation.
na7f50f87da.why_moved: The expansion of BRICS to include six new countries increases the bloc's economic influence, potentially affecting global trade and investment flows.

n2e0464fea6.headline: NGX market capitalization rises by N422bn in 3 days
n2e0464fea6.summary: Nigerian Exchange's market capitalization increased by N422 billion over three days, reaching N35.844 trillion amid bullish trading.
n2e0464fea6.why: Market capitalization growth indicates increased investor confidence and liquidity in Nigeria's stock market.

nf2435238fd.headline: Quinag exits Manappuram Finance; sells entire stake for Rs 1,177 crore
nf2435238fd.summary: Quinag Acquisition offloaded shares in Manappuram Finance at Rs 140.50 each, totaling Rs 1,177 crore.
nf2435238fd.why: Major stake sales can influence stock prices and investor sentiment in the financial sector.

nb3c8febb43.headline: Qantas should not pay back government money: Chalmers
nb3c8febb43.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers states that Qantas should not be required to pay back government funds received during the COVID-19 pandemic.
nb3c8febb43.why: Government support for airlines affects fiscal policy and airline industry stability in Australia, with potential market implications.

ndb5fd6cd13.headline: Qantas soars to $2.5b profit, plans share buyback
ndb5fd6cd13.summary: Qantas Airlines reports a $2.5 billion profit and plans a share buyback, recovering from $7 billion pandemic losses.
ndb5fd6cd13.why: Qantas is a major Australian airline, and its financial recovery impacts airline industry outlook and investor sentiment.

nba0e364904.headline: Fresh fighting in Sudan chokes aid delivery: UN
nba0e364904.summary: Fighting in Sudan disrupts humanitarian aid efforts in South Darfur and South Kordofan.
nba0e364904.why: Conflict impacts regional stability and humanitarian aid, with potential economic and political repercussions.

nee816a56c7.headline: EQS-News: Multitude SE: Multitude with EBIT growth of 66% in H1 fully on track to reach FY 2023 EBIT guidance of EUR 45 million
nee816a56c7.summary: Multitude SE reports a 66% EBIT increase in H1 2023, aligning with its full-year EBIT guidance of EUR 45 million.
nee816a56c7.why: Strong EBIT growth indicates positive financial performance, affecting investor confidence in the company's outlook.

n6b5007b254.headline: IndiGo recommences direct connectivity to Hong Kong
n6b5007b254.summary: India's IndiGo airline announced the restart of Delhi-Hong Kong flights, improving international connectivity.
n6b5007b254.why: Restoring direct routes can increase passenger traffic and revenue for the airline and related sectors.

n020f17efad.headline: Estimating The Intrinsic Value Of CPH Chemie + Papier Holding AG (VTX:CPHN)
n020f17efad.summary: Financial analysis indicates CPH Chemie + Papier's fair value at CHF97.08 based on discounted cash flow models.
n020f17efad.why: Valuation insights influence investor decisions in the Swiss chemical and paper sector.

n6e0c66dba6.headline: Worries over seafood safety mount as Japan releases Fukushima water into the Pacific
n6e0c66dba6.summary: Japan's decision to release Fukushima water into the Pacific sparks criticism from fishermen and China, affecting seafood markets.
n6e0c66dba6.why: Environmental and safety concerns can impact seafood supply chains and international trade relations.

nb7cfc89950.headline: North Sea’s biggest oil and gas producer Harbour Energy reports £337m profit
nb7cfc89950.summary: Harbour Energy, the largest UK North Sea oil and gas producer, reports a £337 million profit, reflecting strong production and market conditions.
nb7cfc89950.why: Harbour Energy's performance indicates the health of UK North Sea oil and gas sector, affecting energy supply and investment.

nd830aa1bf3.headline: Indonesian economy: Weakening resiliency and growth? - Academia
nd830aa1bf3.summary: The Fed and IMF have stated that current monetary policies are not tight enough, raising concerns about Indonesia's economic resiliency and growth prospects.
nd830aa1bf3.why: Indonesia is a major emerging market; monetary policy effectiveness impacts growth and investor sentiment.

ne2351686ff.headline: International Conveyors Ltd acquires equity shares of BSE Ltd for investment
ne2351686ff.summary: International Conveyors Limited acquired 108,023 equity shares of BSE Limited for Rs 10 crore as an investment.
ne2351686ff.why: BSE Limited operates one of India's major stock exchanges; share acquisitions by companies indicate strategic investments or partnerships.

n357d41cd29.headline: NDDC/KPMG signs agreement on corporate governance
n357d41cd29.summary: The Niger Delta Development Commission signed an agreement with KPMG to improve corporate governance standards.
n357d41cd29.why: Improved governance in the Niger Delta Development Commission can enhance transparency and efficiency in managing regional development funds.

n32c025b1a5.headline: Cloud dominates NZ transformation agendas but challenges remain
n32c025b1a5.summary: A report by Spark-owned CCL highlights that cloud technology is central to New Zealand organizations’ transformation agendas despite ongoing challenges.
n32c025b1a5.why: Cloud adoption is a key driver of digital innovation and productivity improvements in businesses, impacting economic growth and technology sectors.

nf1bd5b52c2.headline: REA deploys 103 solar mini-grids, connects 46,661 households
nf1bd5b52c2.summary: The Rural Electrification Agency reported that 46,661 households in off-grid Nigerian communities now have electricity through 103 deployed solar mini-grids.
nf1bd5b52c2.why: Expanding rural electrification supports economic development, improves living standards, and can stimulate local businesses.

n6d03e8a95c.headline: India, Philippine coast guards sign maritime cooperation deal
n6d03e8a95c.summary: The Philippine Coast Guard and Indian Navy signed accords on maritime cooperation and information exchange to enhance maritime safety and security.
n6d03e8a95c.why: Maritime cooperation agreements can improve regional trade security and economic stability in Asia-Pacific.

n904885a11a.headline: Weak data, Nvidia lift risk appetite
n904885a11a.summary: Soft economic data revived hopes that central banks may pause rate hikes, while Nvidia's performance boosted investor risk appetite.
n904885a11a.why: Economic data and major tech earnings influence market sentiment and expectations for monetary policy, affecting equity markets globally.

nba62c28f8f.summary: The Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board has launched a sea time training program for Nigerian maritime cadets in partnership with Stoilic Shipping.
nba62c28f8f.why: Maritime training programs support Nigeria’s local content policies and enhance skills for the country’s shipping and oil sectors.
